explanation.text:
DAVID PROFESSES HIS FAITH IN GOD'S PROMISES. (Sa2 23:1-7)

Now these be the last words of David--Various opinions are entertained as to the precise meaning of this statement, which, it is obvious, proceeded from the compiler or collector of the sacred canon. Some think that, as there is no division of chapters in the Hebrew Scriptures, this introduction was intended to show that what follows is no part of the preceding song. Others regard this as the last of the king's poetical compositions; while still others consider it the last of his utterances as an inspired writer.

raised up on high--from an obscure family and condition to a throne.

the anointed of the God of Jacob--chosen to be king by the special appointment of that God, to whom, by virtue of an ancient covenant, the people of Israel owed all their peculiar destiny and distinguished privileges.

the sweet psalmist of Israel--that is, delightful, highly esteemed.

bsb.text: And David sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.

explanation.text: And he said, The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer. See Gill on Psalm 18:2.

bsb.text: He said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.
My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation. My stronghold, my refuge, and my Savior, You save me from violence.

explanation.text: I will call on the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies. See Gill on Psalm 18:3.

bsb.text: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.

explanation.text: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid. See Gill on Psalm 18:4.

bsb.text: For the waves of death engulfed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.

explanation.text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me. See Gill on Psalm 18:5.

bsb.text: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.

explanation.text:
In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried to my God:

and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears. See Gill on Psalm 18:6.

bsb.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried out to my God. And from His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for help reached His ears.

explanation.text: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth. See Gill on Psalm 18:7.

bsb.text: Then the earth shook and quaked; the foundations of the heavens trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.

explanation.text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it. See Gill on Psalm 18:8.

bsb.text: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.

explanation.text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet. See Gill on Psalm 18:9.

bsb.text: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.

explanation.text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind. See Gill on Psalm 18:10.

bsb.text: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.

explanation.text:
And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters,

and thick clouds of the skies. See Gill on Psalm 18:11.

bsb.text: He made darkness a canopy around Him, a gathering of water and thick clouds.

explanation.text: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled. See Gill on Psalm 18:12.

bsb.text: From the brightness of His presence coals of fire blazed forth.

explanation.text: The Lord thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice. See Gill on Psalm 18:13.

bsb.text: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.

explanation.text: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them. See Gill on Psalm 18:14.

bsb.text: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.

explanation.text: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the Lord, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils. See Gill on Psalm 18:15.

bsb.text: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed at the rebuke of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of His nostrils.

explanation.text: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters. See Gill on Psalm 18:16.

bsb.text: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.

explanation.text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me. See Gill on Psalm 18:17.

bsb.text: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.

explanation.text: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay. See Gill on Psalm 18:18.

bsb.text: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.

explanation.text:
He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me,

because he delighted in me. See Gill on Psalm 18:19.

bsb.text: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.

explanation.text: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me. See Gill on Psalm 18:20.

bsb.text: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.

explanation.text: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God. See Gill on Psalm 18:21.

bsb.text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.

explanation.text: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them. See Gill on Psalm 18:22.

bsb.text: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.

explanation.text: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity. See Gill on Psalm 18:23.

bsb.text: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.

explanation.text: Therefore the Lord hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight. See Gill on Psalm 18:24.

bsb.text: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in His sight.

explanation.text: With the merciful thou wilt show thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt show thyself upright. See Gill on Psalm 18:25.

bsb.text: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;

explanation.text: With the pure thou wilt show thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt show thyself unsavoury. See Gill on Psalm 18:26.

bsb.text: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.

explanation.text: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down. See Gill on Psalm 18:27.

bsb.text: You save an afflicted people, but Your eyes are on the haughty to bring them down.

explanation.text: For thou art my lamp, O Lord: and the Lord will lighten my darkness. See Gill on Psalm 18:28.

bsb.text: For You, O LORD, are my lamp; the LORD lights up my darkness.

explanation.text: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall. See Gill on Psalm 18:29.

bsb.text: For in You I can charge an army; with my God I can scale a wall.

explanation.text: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him. See Gill on Psalm 18:30.

bsb.text: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.

explanation.text: For who is God, save the Lord? and who is a rock, save our God? See Gill on Psalm 18:31.

bsb.text: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?

explanation.text: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect. See Gill on Psalm 18:32.

bsb.text: God is my strong fortress, and He makes my way clear.

explanation.text: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet: and setteth me upon my high places. See Gill on Psalm 18:33.

bsb.text: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.

explanation.text: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms. See Gill on Psalm 18:34.

bsb.text: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

explanation.text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great. See Gill on Psalm 18:35.

bsb.text: You have given me Your shield of salvation, and Your gentleness exalts me.

explanation.text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip. See Gill on Psalm 18:36.

bsb.text: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.

explanation.text: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them. See Gill on Psalm 18:37.

bsb.text: I pursued my enemies and destroyed them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.

explanation.text: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet. See Gill on Psalm 18:38.

bsb.text: I devoured and crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.

explanation.text: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me. See Gill on Psalm 18:39.

bsb.text: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.

explanation.text: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me. See Gill on Psalm 18:40.

bsb.text: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I destroyed those who hated me.

explanation.text: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the Lord, but he answered them not. See Gill on Psalm 18:41.

bsb.text: They looked, but there was no one to save them—to the LORD, but He did not answer.

explanation.text: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad. See Gill on Psalm 18:42.

bsb.text: I ground them as the dust of the earth; I crushed and trampled them like mud in the streets.

explanation.text:
Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people,

thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me. See Gill on Psalm 18:43.

bsb.text: You have delivered me from the strife of my people; You have preserved me as the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.

explanation.text: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me. See Gill on Psalm 18:44.

bsb.text: Foreigners cower before me; when they hear me, they obey me.

explanation.text: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places. See Gill on Psalm 18:45.

bsb.text: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.

explanation.text: The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation. See Gill on Psalm 18:46.

bsb.text: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may God, the Rock of my salvation, be exalted—

explanation.text: It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me. See Gill on Psalm 18:47.

bsb.text: the God who avenges me and brings down nations beneath me,

explanation.text: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man. See Gill on Psalm 18:48.

bsb.text: who frees me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.

explanation.text: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name. See Gill on Psalm 18:49.

bsb.text: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.

explanation.text: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and showeth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore. See Gill on Psalm 18:50.

bsb.text: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.”
